squish.translation: n. 咯吱声, 挤扁\nvt. 把...挤扁, 压扁\nvi. 咯吱咯吱地走

squished.definition: v walk through mud or mire\nv put (a liquid) into a container or another place by means of a squirting action
squished.translation: v. 压扁, 压烂, 咯吱吱地走( squish的过去式 )

squishes.definition: n the noise of soft mud being walked on\nv walk through mud or mire\nv put (a liquid) into a container or another place by means of a squirting action

squishier.translation: <美俚>湿软的, 粘糊糊的, 易压扁的( squishy的比较级 )

squishiest.translation: <美俚>湿软的, 粘糊糊的, 易压扁的( squishy的最高级 )

squishy.definition: s easily squashed; resembling a sponge in having soft porous texture and compressibility
squishy.translation: a. 湿软的, 粘糊糊的

squits.translation: (squit 的复数) n. 无足轻重的人；废话

squitted.translation: (squit 的过去分词) n. 无足轻重的人；废话

squitting.translation: (squit 的现在分词) n. 无足轻重的人；废话

squiz.translation: n. <澳俚>好奇的一看,好奇的一瞥

squoosh.translation: n. 南瓜, 易压烂的物品, 拥挤的人群, 壁球\nv. 压扁, 压制, 镇压, 挤进, 挤压

squop.translation:
squop (plural squops)
(tiddlywinks) A wink that is squopped.


squop (third-person singular simple present squops, present participle squopping, simple past and past participle squopped)
(tiddlywinks) To play a wink so that it comes to rest vertically above some or all parts of another wink.
